caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed object that resembles a stylized seashell or fan, composed of alternating vertical stripes of red-orange and blue. The object is symmetrical and radiates outward from a single point at the bottom. The background is a light, slightly textured off-white color, with faint, irregular marks and patches that suggest shading or a soft, cloudy effect behind the main object. Near the bottom of the shell-like object is a horizontal blue line that is slightly uneven, extending from the left to the right edge of the composition, providing a sense of grounding. In the lower right quadrant of the image, just above the blue line, there is a small, handwritten signature. The overall composition is centered with ample blank space surrounding the main object.
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Painting
